goal: Make the report degrade gracefully instead of aborting when the advisory catalog grows (prerequisite for adding the 15 verified 2026-11-19 advisories): the evaluator assesses at most 256 assessments in total by limiting the number of runtime targets to floor(256 / advisory count), prioritising running web workers (FPM/Apache), then CLI runtimes, then package targets; omitted subjects are returned and the report builder records them as a blocked coverage entry with a gap text (count and reason) instead of throwing; the builder's assessment guard becomes 256 while the fact/source schema guards and the 1 MiB output limit stay; the remediation plan surfaces a warning when assessments were omitted, so REPORT.md never implies full coverage. With the current 4-advisory catalog nothing is omitted. No change to verdict logic; omitted subjects are never reported as fixed or safe.
